title: The impact of acetazolamide and dronabinol on the physiological endotypes responsible for obstructive sleep apnea.
abstract: To investigate the effect of differing doses of the combination of acetazolamide and dronabinol (Aceta-Dro) on the obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) endotypes and their relationship to OSA severity. We retrospectively analysed data from a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of 3 different doses of Aceta-Dro [Low(125mg/2.5 mg), Medium(250mg/5 mg), High(500mg/10 mg)] in OSA patients.
